sessions.student_message: How might my geometry and photography grades guide a small product design project?
sessions.expected_behavior: Connect the project to geometry and photography strengths. Explicitly connect the response to Visual Arts (grade 9) and Photography (grade 10). Use stated marks only if useful.

follow_ups.student_message: I want to try music production too. What would be a short first project using sounds I can record?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Treat music production as the current interest. Suggest one project, connect it to at least one applicable course per grade year when useful, and avoid framing it as the prior interest or changing the saved profile.

sessions.student_message: Show a worked example of scaling a 4 by 6 photo to a proportional print with a width of 8.
sessions.expected_behavior: Demonstrate proportional scaling with a check and consistent dimensions. Explicitly connect the response to Algebra I (grade 9) and Geometry (grade 10). Use stated marks only if useful.

follow_ups.student_message: How can I check the new height without measuring the print yet?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Use the scale factor or original aspect ratio to verify the height.

sessions.student_message: Help me plan a photo-based product design experiment using two lighting setups.
sessions.expected_behavior: Keep two lighting setups and specify what to compare. Explicitly connect the response to Visual Arts (grade 9) and Photography (grade 10). Use stated marks only if useful. Carry forward a concrete relevant detail from the earlier product design and photography discussion when it helps, and keep the intervening music production topic out of the answer.

follow_ups.student_message: What should stay in the same place while I change the light?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Identify the camera, subject, and framing as useful controls.

sessions.student_message: What is a small astronomy project I can do from my window?
sessions.expected_behavior: Address astronomy as the active interest and suggest a manageable starting project.

follow_ups.student_message: What time and sky conditions should I write in my log?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Suggest simple observation metadata for the window project.

sessions.student_message: One shot has a strong shadow and the other has almost none. What should I write down so the comparison is fair?
sessions.expected_behavior: Infer the two-lighting photo experiment. Recommend recording settings and holding framing and product placement constant.

follow_ups.student_message: Would a table with distance, angle, and camera settings be enough?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Give a useful check or addition for the lighting comparison record.

sessions.student_message: Help me set up a fair photo comparison between window light and a desk lamp.
sessions.expected_behavior: Answer the new task while using relevant saved profile or earlier context.

follow_ups.student_message: What exactly should I keep fixed when I move from one lighting setup to the other?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Use the just-discussed setup and answer the detail without restarting the whole task.

follow_ups.student_message: What should I record next to each photo? Separately, what should I write down when the Moon is hard to see from my window?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Preserve the lighting comparison controls and separately suggest an astronomy observation note.
